Movement: No Trunk CompensationMovement Pattern: Arm movement occurs while trunk displacement remains within the functional range required for task execution. No compensatory trunk motion is observed.Onset: Visible arm movement while the trunk remains stable.Offset: Arm returns to calibration position and posture stabilizes.
CalibrationMovement Pattern: Arm rests in a bent position close to the body with no visible trunk or wrist movement.
